# TildaZ v0.10.4

**A Windows-only bug fix. Linux and macOS have no changes in this release.**

- Windows: Korean text no longer shows up as the wrong character (for example `8` in place of `사`) or slanted. This started in v0.9.5. ([#749](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/749))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.4-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.4-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.4-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.4-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.4-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.4-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.4-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.4-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
